title: On micromodes in Bayesian posterior distributions and their implications for MCMC
summary: We investigate the existence and severity of local modes in posterior distributions from Bayesian analyses. These are known to occur in posterior tails resulting from heavy-tailed error models such as those used in robust regression. To understand this phenomenon clearly, we consider in detail location models with Student-$t$ errors in dimension $d$ with sample size $n$. For sufficiently heavy-tailed data-generating distributions, extreme observations become increasingly isolated as $n \to \infty$.
